data.description:
## Context / Problem

`scripts/gen_api_surface.py:92-155` serializes parameter descriptors but omits return annotations although `docs/api-stability.md:24` includes return TypedDicts in the stable subset. A return-only contract regression currently leaves the baseline unchanged.

## Approach

Normalize and serialize stable return annotations with an explicit unannotated sentinel, regenerate the baseline, and add a held-out return-only drift case. Keep cross-Python normalization deterministic and do not expand beyond the documented public surface.

## Scope

- `scripts/gen_api_surface.py`
- `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`
- API-surface gate tests and public-types contract tests

## Testing

Cover annotated return change, unannotated sentinel, nested/typing normalization, and a parameter-identical return-only held-out drift case.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every recorded public callable serializes a stable normalized return annotation or explicit unannotated sentinel.
- [ ] Existing parameter serialization and baseline entries remain compatible except for deliberate return fields.
- [ ] A return-only public API change fails the held-out drift test.
- [ ] Baseline generation is deterministic on supported Python versions and focused API checks pass.
data.title: Include return annotations in public API surface snapshots
